facts.value: Mother with history of heavy menstrual bleeding and postpartum hemorrhage
Maternal grandmother with major depressive disorder
Paternal uncle with frequent epistaxis and easy bruising as a child
outpatient visit, Medical Genetics, Dr. Sarah Chen
Frequent and prolonged nosebleeds over the past year

The episodes typically occur spontaneously and last 10 to 20 minutes despite compression. The patient also reports heavy menstrual periods lasting over 7 days, often with large clots and occasional lightheadedness.
outpatient visit, Hematology and Oncology, Dr. Marcus Rodriguez
Heavy and prolonged menstrual bleeding since menarche

The patient presents to Hematology and Oncology for evaluation of heavy and prolonged menstrual bleeding, following her prior evaluation in January 2020 for frequent and prolonged nosebleeds. Since menarche at age 12, her periods have consistently lasted 8–10 days, and she reports soaking through pads every 1–2 hours on the heaviest days.
outpatient visit, Psychiatry, Dr. Aisha Patel
Behavioral changes, irritability, and loss of interest in activities

The patient is a 14-year-old female with Von Willebrand disease previously evaluated by Medical Genetics and Hematology/Oncology, who presents with behavioral changes. Over the past 3 months, she has become increasingly irritable, has frequent outbursts at home, and her grades have dropped significantly.
